_comment: Date-driven played-fixture treatment for individual event pages.
Read by scripts/build-fixtures.mjs. Each entry applies its edits only once
TODAY (UTC) >= playedFrom, and is idempotent: an edit whose `replace` text is
already present is skipped. Before playedFrom the pass is a strict no-op, so
landing a new entry changes no rendered byte until the event is actually over.
playedFrom = the first day on which the event is in the past (day after the
last day of the event), matching the >= TODAY drop rule used for hub cards.
Replacement copy must be wording already signed off elsewhere on the site, or
a deletion. This file is not a place to write new voice.
